driver: A screen's yield, the share of flagged units that turn out positive, is measured on past populations and carried onto a population whose base rate has moved; the yield is a property of the year it was measured in, the screen's two error rates are what carry across years, so the forward count comes from backing the base rate out of the share now flagged through those error rates, and the year-by-year record, where the yield moves with the base rate while the error rates hold, is what shows it.
driver_concrete: The monitoring standard files the estimand (expected arrivals on the watch list within twelve months from the 30 September 2026 monitored book, one probability per flag status) and a leave-one-cohort-out test that selects the basis (the basis whose largest miss over the four closed cohorts, each predicted from the other three taken together, is smallest), naming no basis. The early-warning system's capture and false-alarm rates hold across the cohorts while its hit rate climbs with each cohort's share of the book reaching the list, so the hit and miss rates miss a closed cohort by 40.6 per cent and the basis that backs each year's share out of its flagged share through the two error rates (Rogan-Gladen) misses none by more than 1.6 per cent: 133 groups, not flags times hit rate (73).
stump: A competent solver rolls the entity signals up to groups, builds the four closed cohorts and sets the probabilities from the share of flagged and of unflagged groups that reached the list over those cohorts taken together, the hit and miss rates the committee is shown each November, and files 73; the step that lands it there is carrying the hit rate onto a book whose flagged share has jumped to 18.1 per cent, when the hit rate moves with each year's share of the book reaching the list and only the screen's capture and false-alarm rates hold across the cohorts; backing this year's arrival share out of the flagged share through those two rates predicts every closed cohort within 1.6 per cent out of sample (the hit rate misses one by 40.6) and gives 133, while trending the hit rate on the flagged share misses by 8.0 and extrapolates to 147.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms every entity signal to its obligor group correctly, reads every clause of CRM-07 correctly and forecasts the easy way, the probability of reaching the list given flag status as the four cohorts taken together measured it (the hit and miss rates), files 73; nothing in the standard names a basis, so only an analyst who sees that the hit rate moves with each year's base rate, and validates the forecast out of sample on the closed cohorts, reaches 133.
domain_test: The call is a credit-monitoring forecast, the watch-list inflow a bank sizes its workout caseload on, built from an early-warning system's performance on obligor groups (signals raised on any legal entity and carried to the group through accounting consolidation, a twelve-month watch-list outcome, the committed book as the monitored population); with another field's nouns in, the group roll-up of entity signals, the watch-list outcome window and the committed-book population have nothing to attach to, and the exposure the arriving groups carry is a credit quantity.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a forward projection for a group as constituted on the projection date, so every past period of its history has to be rebuilt on that membership; joining each period's records to the membership in force in that period, the point-in-time build that history work normally demands, books past changes of membership as growth or shrinkage and moves the projection, upward for groups that absorbed members and downward for groups that shed them.
